title: Add support bundle upload policy design
verified: Support bundle upload is explicitly marked future work and not enabled by the baseline.
Baseline support bundle behavior remains local export only with upload_enabled=false, automatic_upload=false and remote_support_authority=false.
Raw prompts, raw observations, raw secrets, private key material, tokens, passwords and unredacted audit journals remain forbidden upload surfaces.
Future upload requires destination trust, exact operator approval, redaction checks and SecurityExecutionEngine-mediated PlanRun execution.
Untrusted, stale, missing or revoked destinations fail closed and do not mutate local runtime state.
TUI remains a projection surface for upload readiness and may not upload directly or bypass redaction, approval or local audit authority.
risk_notes: Upload execution remains unimplemented and intentionally unavailable in Console Beta.
Future upload must be mediated by AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine, not by TUI direct network code.
Local-only support bundle export remains the production baseline until RC0 supplies destination trust and upload failure evidence.
